chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him about a man who emigrated and left his wife with the polytheists, then she joined him afterwards. [I asked]: Does he keep her with the first marriage, or does her bond of marriage cease? He said: He keeps her, and she is his wife.

key_terms.يُمْسِكُهَا: he keeps her (retains her in marriage)

ai.seo_question: Does a wife's marriage contract remain valid if she stays with polytheists while her husband emigrates and later rejoins him?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), the issue of 'firqah' (separation due to religious difference or migration) is clarified for a wife who remained among polytheists while her husband emigrated. The Imam rules that the marital bond is not automatically severed, meaning the husband retains the right to keep her under the original marriage contract without needing a new ceremony, reflecting the Shia view that temporary separation does not dissolve the nikah unless explicitly divorced. This ruling provides practical legal clarity for early Muslim communities navigating migration and mixed-religion households.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a man who emigrated and left his wife with the Polytheists. Then she met up with him afterwards. Can he keep her with the first marriage or has her chastity been cut off?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He can keep her and she is his wife’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “This is concerning my question before abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,

about the case of a man who migrates and leaves his wife with the pagans, then afterward she joins him; if he can keep her with first marriage or her safety is cut off. He (the Imam) said, ’He can keep her and she is his wife.’”
